essence: The protective armor mantra is to be employed during recitation, fire offering, and similar rites.
By offering parched rice, the practitioner obtains a suitable maiden.
The practitioner will certainly attain universal sovereignty and wealth without doubt.
The practitioner must perform six thousand offerings daily for a full year.
Through this practice, the practitioner becomes a provider of food for everyone in the world.
